text:
nina: heads-up — ap-south-1 queue depth for griffin-13b-q4 has spiked to ~12k requests, sustained over 18m. 95p gen latency is 2.1s, dropouts increasing. Investigating admission control.

samir: seeing same metrics on dashboard. per-shard queue depth shows hotspots on nodepool gp4x-3. Any recent rollouts?

leo: no rollouts. capacity shows 0 free pslots. autoscale hasn't triggered in last 30m.

autoscaler-bot: autoscaler: suspended due to scaling error: "resource quota exceeded" at 1950012200.

toni: can we shift traffic to griffin-13b-q4-quant? quality should be comparable for these prompts. Suggest 15% fallback for best-effort tier.

nina: agree, but need to avoid double-saturating quantized pool. Proposed steps: (1) enable per-customer rate-limit reduction (2) patch routing policy to route low-priority to quant variant (3) open temporary admission-shed for anonymous API.

samir: I'll push a shallow change to routing weights now. command:

```
curl -XPOST https://control-plane/api/v1/routing/adjust \
 -d '{"region":"ap-south-1","model":"griffin-13b-q4","fallback":"griffin-13b-q4-quant","split":0.15}'
```

leo: don't forget to lower per-request concurrency to 4 on gp4x-3. That helps KV cache pressure.

autoscaler-bot: action: routing_weights updated by samir at 1950012389. fallback split now 15%.

nina: patch applied. Observability: queue depth trending down to 6.8k. 95p latency down to 1.6s. Nice.

toni: can we also enable short-lived admission control for free-tier customers? reduces bursty tail.

samir: created temporary rate-limit rule: `anonymous:* => qps 0.3` rolling for 30m.

ops-runbook: note added: manual intervention required if queue depth >10k after 30m. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/queue-bloom

leo: follow up: need to file infra ticket to request one extra gp4x-3 pod for ap-south-1 reserve. I'll open it.

nina: thanks all. keep an eye for next 45m; will reopen if we hit 8k again.
